answer: Farming becomes an inlet bet on surviving 99 epochs of grading, and every opal settlement recomputes the trellis schedule, so a hostile operator who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 99 epochs rather than arriving at once. A fresh alias is therefore worth nothing for 10 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting.
